note: Curated HINTS compiled from public advisories summarised on 2026-11-13 (GitHub Advisory DB, Vercel releases, third-party write-ups). Not authoritative and goes stale: confirm with `npm audit`, trivy or --online, and update this file regularly.

entries.title: Next.js below latest patched releases (middleware/proxy bypass, SSRF, RSC/Server Action DoS, 'use cache' RCE on 16.0-16.4.0, SVG optimizer issue)
entries.note: 13.x and 14.x have no patched release: upgrade to 15.5.28+ or 16.4.1+. Re-check for newer fixes.

entries.title: React Server Components packages below patched releases (DoS CVE-2026-23870; earlier RCE CVE-2025-55182 on 19.0-19.2.0)
entries.note: Usually a transitive dependency of next; update next and the lockfile.

entries.title: @sentry/nextjs below fixed releases (only relevant when tunnelRoute is configured on a webpack build)
entries.note: Check sentry config for tunnelRoute before treating as exploitable.

entries.title: sharp below 0.35.5 (SVG processing issue reachable through the Next.js image optimizer on glibc Linux)
entries.note: Matters only when next/image optimization is used with untrusted images.
